title: Carpio: Lawmakers can discuss, oppose foreign policy
summary: Nothing should stop lawmakers from issuing statements on foreign policy, retired Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Antonio Carpio said as he scored the Department of Foreign Affairs for…

blocks.text: Nothing should stop lawmakers from issuing statements on foreign policy, retired Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Antonio Carpio said as he scored the Department of Foreign Affairs for admonishing officials actively calling out Beijing’s encroachment on the West Philippine Sea.
